messages:
monitoring-bot: [P1] high error rate detected for tenant=orion on pool=orion-dedicated-1. 5xx rate jumped from 0.2% -> 6.8% in last 3m. canary rollout in progress: artifact=rdw-orion:v2026.03.sha:abcdef1234. auto-scale OK. paging oncall @Eric

Eric: got the page, looking. severity P1 if customer impact confirmed. any idea which paths are failing?

Jen: I see timeouts and 500s on /api/generate and /api/chat for orion only. error payloads show KV cache miss + OOM-like tokenization failures on one node in the dedicated pool.

Ravi: I'm on with Orion support channel — they're seeing degraded responses and some truncated outputs. This started ~7m after the canary went to 10% traffic.

Anna: can we isolate traffic for orion to the previous artifact? Prefer pinning rather than full revert if possible — they want minimum disruption but need correctness.

Maria: quick check: the canary revision has new custom tokenizer tweaks. suspect incompat with cached kv entries. command logs below:

```
# check pool allocation
kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=orion-dedicated-1 -o wide
# find pod with high rss
kubectl -n inference top pod orion-infer-22
# inspect container logs
kubectl -n inference logs orion-infer-22 -c runtime | tail -n 100
```

Maria: log snippet: "runtime: kv_cache: unexpected entry size, dropping shard; decoder: tokenization error: unknown token length" repeated. only present on pods serving artifact sha:abcdef1234.

Eric: we need a mitigation plan. options: 1) roll canary back to previous trusted artifact (rdw-orion:v2026.02.sha:112233aabb) and re-pin pool; 2) isolate tenant to a hot path on older pool; 3) emergency patch to tokenizer code (risky). leaning to option 1 + pin. thoughts?

Jen: agree, option 1 is fastest. Can we do a staged revert: remove canary routing (stop new traffic), then re-pin pool to old artifact, then monitor. Keep canary pods around so we can gather deeper logs.

Ravi: Orion prefers quick rollback and a short postmortem. they'll accept a few minutes of failover. Please keep me updated for CS note.

Eric: @DeployBot can you start canary rollback to artifact 112233aabb and set pool pin? include runbook step id if possible.

DeployBot: acknowledged. Initiating canary rollback. Steps:
- set pool.orion-dedicated-1.artifact -> rdw-orion:v2026.02.sha:112233aabb
- set routing.canary.orion-dedicated-1.percent -> 0
- keep old canary pods for logs for 15m
estimated completion 90s

DeployBot: status: 1/3 nodes updated. 3/3 pods restarted on new artifact. healthchecks passing for default routes.

Maria: verifying runtime on restarted pods: tokenizer loads ok, kv_cache initialized, no tokenization errors in latest 30s. tailing logs show requests succeeding.

Jen: monitoring metrics: 5xx rate for tenant orion dropped from 6.8% -> 0.4% within 2m of rollback. latency back to baseline.

Ravi: confirmed with Orion they see restored behaviour, responses normal. thank you. They asked for an RCA and timeline.

Eric: good. marking incident mitigated for customer impact. next steps: keep pods pinned to 112233aabb for 6 hours, gather logs from canary pods, reproduce locally with tokenizer changes, and schedule rollback postmortem with SRE, Runtime, and Cust-Eng.

Anna: I'll draft the customer-facing note: short summary, what we rolled back, ETA for RCA. Ravi — can you approve before I send?

Ravi: please include: exact window of impact (approx 7m), that we rolled back to rdw-orion:v2026.02.sha:112233aabb, and that we're investigating tokenizer compatibility. approved.

DeployBot: final deploy status: rollback complete. pool.pin=112233aabb. routing.canary.percent=0.

Eric: handing off to night oncall @Jen for monitoring and follow-up. Jen, please escalate if we see recurrence.

Jen: on it. I'll keep the thread open and post a brief RCA draft by EOD. added follow-ups to runbook:
- run integration test suite with new tokenizer on local harness
- add pre-rollout tokenizer compatibility check to canary gating
- longer retention for canary logs for 24h

monitoring-bot: note: incident P1 -> mitigated (customer-facing). alerts suppressed for affected pool for 30m to avoid noise.

Eric: thanks team. closing oncall for now. :thumbsup:
